name: Describe historic racing accidents and failed team entries
description: Users asked for detailed accounts of specific motorsport accidents, fatal crashes, and the failed or fictional projects of racing teams attempting to enter major championships. These descriptions focused on the causes, consequences, and logistical challenges of these high-risk or defunct entities, excluding general race recaps or driver performance summaries.
